Description:FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001] The present invention relates to a automated dough ball preparation device that is capable of preparing dough balls and enabling users to specify the desired dimensions of each dough ball, thereby eliminating the need for manual shaping and ensuring consistent results across all dough balls.

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
 
[0002]  Dough ball preparation is an arduous and physically demanding process, especially when done manually. The procedure typically involves several labor-intensive steps, including kneading the dough to achieve the right consistency, portioning it into uniform sizes, and rolling each piece into a smooth ball. This process requires considerable effort and time, as ensuring uniformity and quality is painstaking. Manual handling of the dough often leads to fatigue and inconsistency, as the dough stick to hands and surfaces, complicating the task further. Additionally, maintaining proper hygiene and avoiding cross-contamination while working with dough adds another layer of complexity. For large-scale or commercial operations, the physical strain increases significantly, as the volume of dough to be processed is substantial. The repetitive nature of the task and the need for precision make dough ball preparation not only tiring but also mentally taxing. Consequently, automating this process with advanced machinery significantly reduce the physical burden and enhance efficiency, ensuring consistent quality while alleviating the strain on workers.

[0003]  Traditional methods of making dough balls involve manual processes such as hand kneading, portioning, and rolling, each of which presents its own set of drawbacks. Hand kneading requires significant physical effort to achieve the right dough consistency, often leading to uneven texture and fatigue. Portioning dough into uniform sizes by hand is time-consuming and prone to inconsistency, affecting the quality and uniformity of the final product. Rolling the dough balls manually is labor-intensive and result in variations in size and shape, which impacts the cooking or baking outcomes. Furthermore, the manual nature of these processes lead to hygiene concerns, as ensuring clean hands and surfaces is challenging. The repetitive motions involved can also lead to repetitive strain injuries for workers. Additionally, traditional methods are often less efficient for large-scale production, as they rely heavily on human labor and become bottlenecks in high-volume operations. These drawbacks highlight the need for automated solutions that improve consistency, efficiency, and reduce physical strain, making the dough ball preparation process more streamlined and hygienic.

[0004] US5375509A discloses about an invention that discloses and provides a dough preparation and dividing machine capable of receiving substantially spherical, filled encrusted dough balls and forming them, with a minimum of dough working, into flattened, "D"-shaped configurations to increase the output of a conventional encrusting and co-extruding device for filled, encrusted dough ball products. Although, US’509 discloses about an invention that provides a means for dough preparation. However, the cited invention lacks in enhance user experience by alerting the user when the dough balls are ready for collection, ensuring timely retrieval and reducing any potential delays or interruptions in the workflow.
 
[0005] Conventionally, many methods are available for making doughballs. However, the cited invention lacks in achieving high precision in the handling and processing of dough for accurately positioning, rolling, and sizing the dough according to user-defined specifications, thus ensuring uniformity in the final product.

[0006] In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a device that is capable of enhance user experience by alerting the user when the dough balls are ready for collection, ensuring timely retrieval and reducing any potential delays or interruptions in the workflow.

 OBJECTS OF THE INVENTION

[0007]  The principal object of the present invention is to overcome the disadvantages of the prior art.

[0008]  An object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of preparing dough balls and enabling users to specify the desired dimensions of each dough ball, thereby eliminating the need for manual shaping and ensuring consistent results across all dough balls.

[0009] Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that achieve high precision in the handling and processing of dough for accurately positioning, rolling, and sizing the dough according to user-defined specifications, thus ensuring uniformity in the final product.

[0010] Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that enhance user experience by alerting the user when the dough balls are ready for collection, ensuring timely retrieval and reducing any potential delays or interruptions in the workflow.

[0011] Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a device that dispense an edible lubricant to prevent the dough from sticking to processing surfaces, thus facilitating smoother rolling and shaping processes and improving the overall functionality.

[0012] The foregoing and other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become readily apparent upon further review of the following detailed description of the preferred embodiment as illustrated in the accompanying drawings.

SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

The housing 101 is constructed from material that include but not limited to durable, corrosion-resistant material, such as stainless steel or high-grade aluminum, to ensure longevity and ease of cleaning in a food preparation environment. [0025]  A microcontroller manages the device's operations by interfacing with the touch-enabled screen 103. Upon receiving input commands from the user through the screen 103, the microcontroller processes these inputs to determine the desired dimensions and specifications for the dough balls. [0026]  A telescopic gripper 104 mounted on a platform within the housing 101, is operated by the microcontroller to handle and position the dough accurately. This gripper 104 consists of multiple segments that extend and retract, enabling it to reach and manipulate dough of varying sizes. The operation of the gripper 104 is driven by a pneumatic unit, which includes an air compressor, air cylinders, air valves, and pistons. The microcontroller sends signals to these pneumatic components to adjust the gripper's position, opening or closing it as needed to grasp the dough securely and place it precisely on the platform.

[0027]  Simultaneously, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 105, integrated within the housing 101 determines the presence of the dough on the platfrom. This imaging unit 105 consists of high-resolution cameras and a dedicated processor that work together to monitor the platform where the dough is placed. The cameras capture detailed images of the platform and the dough, which are then fed into the processor. The processor utilizes advanced AI protocols to analyze these images, detecting the presence, position, and dimensions of the dough.

[0028]  The AI protocol employed in the imaging unit 105 are designed to recognize patterns and features specific to the dough. They perform tasks such as edge detection, object segmentation, and size measurement to ensure that the dough is correctly positioned and meets the specified dimensions. If the imaging unit 105 detects any discrepancies, such as the dough being misaligned or not meeting the required size, it sends this information to the microcontroller. The microcontroller, in turn, adjusts the gripper's position, the rolling mechanism, or other relevant components to correct the issue and ensure precise dough ball formation.

[0029] A plate 106 is installed on the platform via an L-shaped telescopically operated rod 107 for the precise rolling and shaping of the dough. The L-shaped telescopic rod 107 is developed to adjust the plate 106's height relative to the platform based on the detected dimensions and requirements of the dough balls. The telescopic rod 107 comprises several segments that extend or retract, allowing for fine adjustments in the distance between the plate 106 and the platform. When the artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 105, which continuously monitors the dough's presence and dimensions, detects that dough is correctly positioned on the platform, this signals the microcontroller. The microcontroller then processes this data and activates the telescopic rod 107 through a pneumatic actuator to adjust the plate 106's distance from the platform. This adjustment ensures that the space between the plate 106 and the platform is optimized according to the specific dimensions required for the dough balls, accommodating varying sizes and thicknesses of dough.

[0030]  Once the correct distance is established, a motorized slider 108 configured between the telescopic rod 107 and the plate 106 provides a controlled to-and-fro motion, facilitating the rolling of the dough. The slider 108 is powered by an electric motor, depending on the design, and it is programmed to move the plate 106 back and forth across the dough. This motion is crucial for evenly rolling out the dough to the desired thickness and consistency. The rolling action is carefully controlled to ensure that the dough is spread uniformly and consistently, which is essential for producing dough balls of uniform size and quality.

[0031]  A motorized hinge 109 is installed on the platform to facilitate the tilting of the platform for transferring the rolled dough onto a subsequent processing stage. As dough is processed, the microcontroller constantly monitors the rolling operation through data from the artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 105. This imaging unit 105 captures real-time images of the dough on the platform, allowing the device to detect when the dough has been rolled to the desired thickness and consistency. Once the microcontroller confirms that the rolling process is complete, it triggers the motorized hinge 109. The motorized hinge 109 is designed to tilt the platform at a controlled angle, enabling a seamless transfer of the rolled dough. This tilting is powered by an electric motor that adjusts the angle of the hinge 109 according to the requirements. The hinge 109’s tilting action is precise, ensuring that the rolled dough moves smoothly from the platform onto a primary rectangular member 110. 

[0032] The primary rectangular member 110 is mounted on the side wall of the housing 101 and is carved with a plurality of grooves 111. These grooves 111 are integral to the next stage of dough processing. As the platform tilts, gravity assists in guiding the rolled dough toward this member 110. The specific angle of tilt is crucial, as this align with the dimensions and grooves 111 of the primary member 110 to ensure the dough is properly positioned for further processing. This alignment is managed by the microcontroller, which adjusts the hinge 109’s angle to achieve the correct tilt based on the detected dough dimensions.

[0033] A secondary rectangular member 112 is equipped with a plurality of grooves 111 that are designed to work in conjunction with the primary rectangular member 110, which also has grooves 111. The secondary member 112 is installed above the primary member 110 and is positioned with the aid of an L-shaped telescopically operated link 113. The purpose of this arrangement is to create a controlled space between the two members where the rolled dough is pressed into dough balls of the desired size and shape. This link 113 connects the secondary rectangular member 112 to the primary one. The "L-shaped" refers to the structural design of the link 113, which allows it to extend and retract along its length. This telescopic action is powered by a pneumatic unit that enable precise adjustments. The microcontroller controls the operation of this link 113, adjusting its length to maintain a suitable distance between the primary and secondary member 112. This distance is crucial as it determines how the dough is compressed and divided into balls.

[0034] When the rolled dough is transferred onto the primary member 110, the microcontroller senses this through input from imaging unit 105. Based on the detected dimensions and the amount of dough, the microcontroller actuates the L-shaped link 113 to either extend or retract. This adjustment ensures that the secondary member 112 is positioned correctly relative to the primary member 110 to accommodate the dough.

[0035] Once the correct distance is established, the motorized sliding unit 114 attached to the L-shaped link 113 and provides a to-and-fro motion along the length of the link 113. The sliding action allows the secondary member 112 to move back and forth, pressing the dough between the primary and secondary member 112. The motion is carefully controlled by the microcontroller to ensure that the dough is evenly pressed into the grooves 111 of the primary member 110 and shaped accurately according to the user-defined dimensions. This to-and-fro motion helps in dividing the dough into evenly sized balls, as the grooves 111 in the primary member 110 guide and shape the dough during the pressing process.

[0036] A motorized pin joint is integrated with the primary rectangular member 110 to tilt the primary member 110 once the dough balls have been formed. This joint is powered by an electric motor, which is directly actuated by the microcontroller based on the processing status of the dough.

[0037] The process begins when the dough balls are pressed and shaped between the primary and secondary member 112. Once the dough balls are adequately formed, the microcontroller sends a signal to activate the motorized pin joint. The pin joint then initiates a tilting motion of the primary member 110. The tilt angle is carefully calibrated to ensure that the dough balls slide smoothly from the primary member 110 onto the tray without being damaged or misaligned. The tilting action of the motorized pin joint is precisely controlled to avoid any abrupt movements that might disrupt the formation or position of the dough balls. The microcontroller manages the speed and angle of the tilt, ensuring a gradual and steady transfer of the dough balls. This control is vital for maintaining the consistency and quality of the dough balls, as a sudden or uneven tilt could lead to deformation or spillage.

[0038] A tray, positioned at the base of the housing 101, is developed to collect the transferred dough balls. The tray is equipped with features such as a non-stick surface or dividers to organize the dough balls and prevent them from sticking together. The precise alignment between the primary member 110 and the tray is crucial for ensuring that the dough balls land in an orderly manner, making them easier to collect and handle.

[0039] Once the transfer of dough balls is complete, the microcontroller activates a speaker 115 mounted on the housing 101. This feature enhances the user experience by providing a simple yet effective means of communication, ensuring that the user can efficiently manage the completion of the process and retrieve the finished product without delay.

[0040] A pair of electronic nozzles 116 are developed to work in tandem to deliver a controlled amount of edible oil onto the surfaces where the dough is handled. The container 117 is usually equipped with a pump to ensure a consistent and reliable flow of oil to the nozzles 116. The placement of the nozzles 116 near the platform and primary member 110 allows for precise application of oil exactly where it is needed, minimizing waste and optimizing the dough handling process.

[0041] The microcontroller manages the operation of the electronic nozzles 116. The microcontroller determines when and how much oil needs to be dispensed based on various factors, such as the amount of dough on the platform, the thickness of the rolled dough, and the specific requirements of the dough ball formation process. By activating the nozzles 116 at the right times, the microcontroller ensures that the surfaces are adequately lubricated to prevent the dough from sticking.

[0042] During the rolling phase, the dough easily become sticky, adhering to the platform or the primary member 110, which hinder the smooth operation of the device and affect the quality of the final dough balls. The electronic nozzles 116 address this issue by dispensing a thin, even layer of edible oil onto the surfaces. This layer of oil acts as a lubricant, reducing friction between the dough and the surfaces, which facilitates smoother rolling and easier movement of the dough. The consistent application of oil helps maintain the dough's integrity, ensuring that it does not tear or deform during processing.

Description:FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001] The present invention relates to an ear protection film sticking assistive device that is designed to apply protective coverings around sensitive areas such as the ear for safeguarding the ear from environmental elements, ensuring both effective coverage and user comfort.

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
 
[0002] Ear protection films are essential for shielding the ear from external elements and maintaining hygiene. Traditionally, users manually apply adhesive films or covers over their ears. To achieve this, users often relied on manual methods, including hand application or simple adhesive strips. These traditional methods were labour-intensive and lacked precision, resulting in difficulties ensuring proper placement and adhesion. Additionally, they often led to poor coverage, insufficient protection, or discomfort. The lack of a standardized approach made it challenging to apply the protection layer uniformly, affecting overall effectiveness and comfort. 

[0003]  Early methods involved manually applying adhesive films or covers to the ear using hands or simple tools. Users cut adhesive strips or protective films to size and place them over the ear. However, manual placement often led to inconsistent coverage and poor adhesion. Also, improper application could cause discomfort or irritation due to misalignment. And the process was time-consuming and required careful handling to avoid mistakes. Hence, an equipment needs to be developed that assist people in applying insulation sheet over the ear portion for protecting the ear. 

[0004] JP2000333730A discloses about an invention that includes an ear protection pad comprising a cover protection device intended to protect the ear and its surrounding against a chemical such as a hairdye has a pasting device, a fixing clamp, a fitting device and an edge. Although JP’730 relates to an ear protection pad. But the cited invention fails to adjusts to the specific dimensions and shape of each individual’s ear.  

[0005] US20150223987A1 discloses about an invention that includes a method for fabricating an earband/earmuff, according to an embodiment herein. The first step for fabricating an earband/earmuff is by fixing or adhering the “O” shaped rings. The next step is coating and sewing pu leather around the plastic band. Further obtaining a flat and smooth surface on plastic band after coating with pu leather. The next step is adhering a plurality of rhinestones/charms/custom emblem or logos on earband/earmuff with a glue. The next step is testing the earband/earmuff for strength by subjecting to a temperature below 0° C. temperature and above 90° C. temperature. The rhinetsones do not separate from the earband because of the adhesive in different temperature ranges. A glue “E 6000®” is applied for adhering the rhinestones on the smooth surface of the earband or earmuff. The glue “E 6000®” comprises of tetrachloroethylene. The quantity of tetracholoroethylene is present in 60-100 weight %. Though US’987 relates to a method for fabricating an ear band/earmuff for protecting user’s ear. But the cited invention lacks in applying the protective layer with the correct amount of pressure and alignment. 
 
[0006] Conventionally, many devices have been developed that are capable of aiding a user in applying insulation sheet over the user ear. However, these devices fail to adjust to the specific dimensions and shape of each individual’s ear. Additionally, these existing devices also lack in applying the protective layer with the correct amount of pressure and alignment. 

[0007] In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a device that adjusts to the specific dimensions and shape of each ear, ensuring that the protective layer fits snugly and securely, offering optimal protection and comfort. In addition, the developed device also guides the user to apply the protective layer with the correct amount of pressure and alignment, thus ensuring effective adhesion and coverage.

[0009]  An object of the present invention is to develop a device that is able to ensure that a protective layer is applied with high precision to fit the unique shape and contours of an individual's ear, thereby providing comprehensive coverage and protection against external elements.

[0010] Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that adjusts to the specific dimensions and shape of each ear, ensuring that the protective layer fits snugly and securely, offering optimal protection and comfort.

[0011]  Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of guiding the user to apply the protective layer with the correct amount of pressure and alignment, thus ensuring effective adhesion and coverage.

[0023] A body 101 used herein comprises of a handy and portable elongated structure arranged with various components associated with the device, wherein the body 101 is made up of material that includes but not limited to plastic or metal that ensures that the device is of generous size and is light in weight. 

[0024] In order to facilitate a user in acquiring a secure grip over the body 101, a handle 102 is attached on the body 101. As the user securely holds the body 101, the user manually switches on/off the device, by pressing a push button which is installed on the body 101 to activate the device in view of operating several components via an inbuilt microcontroller. 

[0025] The microcontroller, mentioned herein, is preferably an Arduino microcontroller. The Arduino microcontroller used herein controls the overall functionality of the components linked to it. The Arduino microcontroller is an open-source programming platform. The microcontroller receives the data from various electronic units and generates a command signal for further processing. 

[0026]  On free end of the body 101 a circular member 103 is arranged which is positioned by the user in nearby of the ear portion. As the user places the body 101 in nearby of the ear portion. The microcontroller detects placement of the body 101 in vicinity to the individual’s ear portion via an ultrasonic sensor which is arranged on the body 101. 

[0027]  The ultrasonic sensor works by emitting ultrasonic waves and then measuring the time taken by these waves to bounce back after hitting the individual’s ear portion. The ultrasonic sensor includes two main parts viz. transmitter, and a receiver. The transmitter sends a short ultrasonic pulse towards the individual’s ear portion which propagates through the air at the speed of sound and reflects back as an echo to the transmitter as the pulse hits the individual’s ear portion. 

[0028] The transmitter then detects the reflected eco from the individuals ear portion and calculations is performed by the sensor based on the time interval between the sending signal and receiving echo to determine the placement of the individuals ear portion. 

[0029] The determined data is sent to the microcontroller in a signal form, based on which the microcontroller further process the signal to detect whether the placement of the body 101 nearby the individual ear portion is successful or not, in case the placement of the body 101 nearby the individual ear portion is successful the microcontroller activates an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 104 which is installed on the body 101. 

[0030] On getting the actuation command the imaging unit 104 captures and records multiple images in vicinity to the body 101 by rotating in 360 degrees. The imaging unit 104 disclosed herein comprises of an image capturing arrangement including a set of lenses that captures multiple images of the surroundings and the captured images are stored within memory of the imaging unit 104 in form of an optical data. The imaging unit 104 also comprises of the processor which processes the captured images. 

[0031] This pre-processing involves tasks such as noise reduction, image stabilization, or color correction. The processed data is fed into AI protocols for analysis which utilizes machine learning techniques, such as deep learning neural networks, to extract meaningful information from the visual data which are processed by the microcontroller to detect dimensions of the individual’s ear portion.

Description:FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001] The present invention relates to an adaptable water-flow management assistive device that is capable of providing a means to distribute water from a single tap in a systematic manner to provide the required flow for user-desired purposes and reduce wastage of water.

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
 
[0002]  Effective water-flow management is essential to ensure optimal use and conservation of the water. Distributing water from a single source is a good solution to reduce wastage which is quite inefficient and challenging, especially if the distribution needs to be adjustable for various applications like cooling or irrigation. Adjusting water flow to different sections or areas is complex without a structured framework.

[0003]  Traditionally, there are many available devices for water-flow management. Manual valves are basic devices used to control water flow by physically opening or closing a valve which are commonly found in irrigation systems, plumbing, and industrial applications. But these often require physical adjustment which is time-consuming, especially in large systems. Flow meters measure the volume or rate of water flow through a pipe or channel. However, these do not adjust flow rates automatically and cannot be integrated with other systems or provide automatic adjustments based on changing conditions.

[0004] CN110740805B discloses a flow distribution system for distributing and splitting the flow of at least two separate fluids, the distribution system comprising: a three-dimensional nested structure of at least two fluid delivery fractal, including at least a first fluid delivery fractal and a second fluid delivery fractal, each fluid delivery fractal having a respective fluid inlet opening diverging to a plurality of fluid outlet openings, each fluid delivery fractal configured to facilitate flow therethrough independent of flow in the other fluid delivery fractal, each fluid delivery fractal extending along and about a central axis between the fluid inlet opening and the plurality of fluid outlet openings; wherein each fluid delivery fractal comprises a series of recursive furcation units assembled in a selected number of stages, each furcation unit comprising a Y-shaped furcation element fluidly connected to two consecutive furcation units, each consecutive furcation unit being rotated relative to a central axis by an angle between 60 degrees and 120 degrees relative to a preceding stage; each fluid conveying fractal is interlaced with another fluid conveying fractal; each fluid delivery fractal is positioned offset from the other fluid delivery fractal about a central axis and arranged such that each fluid outlet from one of the fluid delivery fractal is positioned adjacent to the fluid outlet of the other fluid delivery fractal and each fluid delivery fractal is centered on a flow axis that is laterally inclined from the central axis from greater than 0 degrees to 20 degrees and longitudinally inclined from the central axis from greater than 0 degrees to 20 degrees. Though CN’805 discloses a flow distribution system for distributing and splitting the flow of at least two separate fluids. However, the cited art lacks in adjusting the outlet’s dimension according to the pipe’s dimension to properly engage the pipe with the outlet.

[0005] US10775213B2 discloses a fluid manifold is capable of channeling and monitoring fluid flow within a fluid distribution system. The manifold includes one or more input lumens. Each input lumen associated with a respective inlet port. The manifold also includes a plurality of output lumens such that each output lumen is associated with a respective outlet port and at least one input lumen is coupled to two or more output lumens. The manifold also includes one or more flow sensors capable of measuring fluid flow parameters of fluid flowing through at least one of the one or more input lumens and the plurality of output lumens. In some implementations, a flow sensor can be mounted to each output lumen of the manifold. Though US’213 discloses a fluid manifold is capable of channeling and monitoring fluid flow within a fluid distribution system. However, the cited art lacks in adjusting the temperature of the water according to the different purposes it is used for.
 
[0006] Conventionally, many devices exist for managing the distribution of water to reduce wastage and conserve water. However, the cited arts have certain limitations pertaining to adjusting the outlet’s dimension according to the pipe’s dimension to properly engage the pipe with the outlet. Additionally, the devices also lack in adjusting the temperature of the water according to the different purposes it is used for.

[0007] In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a device that is capable of managing water flow from a water tap according to a user’s need for different purposes.

 OBJECTS OF THE INVENTION

[0008]  The principal object of the present invention is to overcome the disadvantages of the prior art.

[0009] An object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of getting accommodated onto any water tap by means of a flexible, adjustable mechanism to ensure a proper attachment. 

[0010] Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of adjusting according to a variety of pipes used for different purposes to provide a secure fit to each of the pipes ensuring that the pipes are properly engaged with the tap.

[0011]  Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of adjusting the flow of water according to the user's requirement for a specific purpose to ensure that no water is wasted in areas where it’s not required.
     
[0012]  The foregoing and other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become readily apparent upon further review of the following detailed description of the preferred embodiment as illustrated in the accompanying drawings.

SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

[0013]  The present invention relates to an adaptable water-flow management assistive device that is capable of getting accommodated over a variety of water taps to distribute the water flow according to the user’s requirement for different purposes to ensure optimal use of the water.

[0014]  According to an embodiment of the present invention, an adaptable water-flow management assistive device comprises of a hollow cuboidal body assembled with a cylindrical structure positioned in proximity to a water tap, a microphone integrated in body for enabling a user to provide input voice commands regarding installation of the body on the tap, an ultrasonic sensor embedded in the body for determining dimensions of the tap’s outlet, a motorized iris lid installed at top portion of the structure that is actuated by an inbuilt microcontroller for allowing a user to overlap the structure’s inlet to the tap outlet, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit integrated in the body to detect positioning of user-desired pipes of varying dimensions in proximity to the body along with dimensions of the pipe’s inlet. 

[0015] According to another embodiment of the prevent invention, the proposed device also includes plurality of cylindrical members arranged on bottom portion of the body and integrated with a drawer arrangement to increase/decrease dimensions of the members to engage the pipes’ inlet with the members, plurality of flaps arranged within the body at fixed distances through a motorized hinge joint for deploying the flaps to form required sections for diverting flow of the water towards required pipes, a speaker installed on the body for producing audio signals to guide the user to open the tap, a temperature sensor embedded in the members for detecting the temperature of the water, plurality of Peltier units arranged in the members for providing optimum heating/cooling effect to the water flowing through the members for maintaining appropriate temperature, a battery is configured with the device for providing a continuous power supply to electronically powered components associated with the device.

[0016]  While the invention has been described and shown with particular reference to the preferred embodiment, it will be apparent that variations might be possible that would fall within the scope of the present invention.

[0021] The present invention relates to an adaptable water-flow management assistive device that is capable of getting accommodated over a water tap and connecting with a variety of different pipes to provide a means for distributing the water according to the user’s requirement to minimize wastage and conserve water.

[0022]  Referring to Figure 1, an isometric view of an adaptable water-flow management assistive device is illustrated, comprising a hollow cuboidal body 101 assembled with a cylindrical structure 102, a microphone 103 integrated with the body 101, a motorized iris lid 104 installed at the top portion of the structure 102, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 105 integrated with the body 101, plurality of cylindrical members 106 arranged on the bottom portion of the body 101 and integrated with a drawer arrangement 107, plurality of flaps 108 arranged within the body 101 at fixed distances through a motorized hinge joint 109, a speaker 110 is installed on the body 101 and an ultrasonic sensor 111 embedded in the body 101.

[0023]  The proposed device includes a hollow cuboidal body 101 that is placed in proximity to a water tap. The body 101 is made up of a material that may include but not limited to plastic, aluminum, steel, or any other metallic material. Body 101 may remain in contact with the water for longer durations so the material is rust-free. The material is tough and durable as the body 101 may come in contact with several environmental factors. 

[0024] Body 101 is connected to a cylindrical structure 102 to be fitted over the water tap for installing body 101 with the tap. The body 101 is integrated with a microphone 103 to enable a user to provide voice commands for installing the body 101 on the tap. When the user speaks to a microphone 103 to give voice commands, it first captures the sound waves from the voice. 

[0025] These sound waves hit the diaphragm which vibrates back and forth in response to sound waves. This movement is then transferred to a capacitor connected to the microphone 103 that converts the vibrations into an electrical signal that mirrors the pattern of the sound waves. This signal is sent to an inbuilt microcontroller in the device.

[0026] The microcontroller is pre-fed with a defined set of instructions to perform various functions.  The microcontroller is a small integrated circuit that controls specific functions by executing a program stored in its memory. It consists of a central processing unit (CPU), memory, and I/O ports for interacting with external components of the device. When powered on, it fetches and executes instructions received from the device's component. 

[0027]  The microcontroller actuates an ultrasonic sensor 111 embedded in the body 101 to determine the dimensions of the tap’s outlet. The ultrasonic sensor 111 operates by emitting high-frequency sound waves from a transducer which travels towards the outlet of the tap and reflects to the sensor 111. The sensor 111 measures the time it takes for the sound waves to return after bouncing off the tap. The sensor 111 measures multiple waves from different angles. The time taken between sending and receiving the waves is used to calculate the dimension of the tap’s outlet which is crucial for installing the body 101 properly on the tap.

[0028] Based on the detected dimensions, the microcontroller actuates a motorized iris lid 104 configured at the top portion of the structure 102 to fit over the tap. The iris lid 104 is an adjusting circular aperture comprised of an actuation ring and a plurality of blades according to the size of the lid 104. The blades are engraved with the protrusions through which actuation ring is connected to the blade. 

[0029] The actuation ring is connected to a control mechanism, such as a motor, which helps in the movement of the actuation ring leading to the movement of blades inward or outward to change the size of the opening. When the blades close, the aperture becomes smaller, closing the lid 104. When the blades open, the aperture widens, opening the lid 104. This adjustment mechanism allows to adjust the iris lid 104 as per the dimensions of the tap’s outlet to install the body 101 on the tap. 

[0030] After the body 101 is secured over the tap, the microcontroller actuates an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 105 integrated in the body 101. The imaging unit 105 comprises of a camera that captures a high-resolution image of the surroundings of the body 101. Then, the processor linked with the imaging unit 105 extracts the required feature from the image which includes first pre-processing of the image to enhance clarity and identify the position of the pipes the user desires to attach to the body 101 along with the dimensions of the pipes’ inlet. The processor then sends the detected position and dimension to the microcontroller.

[0031]  The body 101 is arranged with plurality of cylindrical members 106 on the bottom portion to engage the user-desired pipes with the body 101. Each member 106 is attached to a drawer arrangement 107 that is actuated by the microcontroller to increase/decrease the dimensions of the member 106 to engage with the inlet of the user-desired pipes. 

[0032] The drawer arrangement 107 comprises of two plates which are connected through a slider. The slider consists of a sliding rail and a motorized slidable component connected to the sliding rail. The slidable component is attached to the sliding rail from one end and to the first plate from the other end. The sliding rail is connected to the component from one end and to the second plate from the other end. The component is attached to a motor which provides movement in a bi-directional manner that is translated to the plates. The plates expand/contract to adjust the opening of each member 106 as per the detected dimensions of the pipes to engage the pipes in a secured manner. 

[0033] After user-desired pipes are connected to the member 106, the user again provides the input through the microphone 103 to inform about the required water-flow from each of the connected pipe as per requirement for performing different tasks. The microphone 103 works in the same manner as described earlier.

[0034] Based on the user’s input for the required water flow, the microcontroller actuates plurality of flaps 108 arranged within the body 101 at fixed distances. Each of the flaps 108 is connected through a motorized hinge joint 109 to provide movement to the flap 108 according to the user’s requirement of the water flow. The hinge joint 109 comprises of two parts, one part of the hinge has a cylindrical shape, while the other part has a corresponding groove to fit the first part over it. This configuration allows the hinge to pivot around a fixed axis. 

[0035] The joint 109 is powered by a motor to provide rotational force. A mechanical linkage transmits the motor’s rotational motion to the hinge joint 109. The transmission mechanism converts the motor’s rotational force into the movement of the hinge joint 109 which allows the joint 109 to converge/diverge for deploying the flaps 108 to form sections to divert the flow of the water in the required pipe to perform the required function.

[0036] The microcontroller also actuates a speaker 110 installed on the body 101 to provide instructions to the user to open and close the tap. The speaker 110 works by converting the electrical signal into the audio signal. It consists of a cone known as a diaphragm attached to a coil-shaped wire placed between two magnets. When the electric signal is passed through the voice coil, it generates a varying magnetic field that interacts with the magnet causing the diaphragm to move back and forth. This movement pushes and pulls air creating sound waves just like the electrical signal received and used to notify the user to close the tap if the water is not required to prevent wastage of the water.

[0037] The members 106 is embedded with a temperature sensor to detect the temperature of the water flowing through the pipes. The temperature probe measures temperature by coming in contact with the flowing water. The probe is made up of a sensing element and a transducer. The sensing element is like a semiconductor or ceramic that responds to temperature changes, such as a resistor, thermocouple, or thermistor. The probe is submerged in the water and the sensing element detects a change in the water's temperature. The sensing element then creates a small electric signal that changes depending on the temperature. The transducer translates the signal into a readable format and sends it to the microcontroller.

[0038]  The microcontroller then actuates plurality of Peltier units installed with the members 106 to adjust the temperature of the water according to the user’s requirement. The peltier unit works on the Peltier effect where a temperature difference is created by transferring heat between two electrical junctions. A voltage applied across two conductors joined together creates an electrical current. 

[0039] When an electric current is passed, electrons move from a high-energy state to a lower-energy state and release energy in the form of heat. At one junction, the movement of electrons absorbs heat from the surroundings making that side cold while other side where the movement of electrons releases energy, it becomes hot. When the water is a bit on the hotter side, the Peltier unit lowers the temperature to make the water cooler and vice versa.

[0040] Moreover, a battery is associated with the device to supply power to electrically powered components that are employed herein. The battery is comprised of a pair of electrodes known as a cathode and an anode. A voltage is generated between the anode and cathode via oxidation/reduction and thus produces the electrical energy to provide to the device.

After this, plurality of Peltier units is arranged in the members 106 to provide optimum heating/cooling effect to the water flowing through the members 106 for maintaining appropriate temperature.

ii) an ultrasonic sensor 111 embedded in said body 101 for determining dimensions of said tap’s outlet, wherein a motorized iris lid 104 installed at top portion of said structure 102 that is actuated by an inbuilt microcontroller to get opened/closed for allowing a user to overlap said structure’s 102 inlet to said tap outlet, in view of securing said body 101 with said tap;

v) plurality of flaps 108 arranged within said body 101 at fixed distances, each by means of a motorized hinge joint 109 that are actuated by said microcontroller to provide converging/diverging movement to said flaps 108 for deploying said flaps 108 to form required sections, for diverting flow of said water towards required pipes, as per said user’s requirements, while preventing unnecessary flow of water in non-required areas, thereby assisting said user in managing distribution of said water flow for different user-desired purposes.

2) The device as claimed in claim 1, wherein a speaker 110 is installed on said body 101 for producing audio signals to guide said user to open said tap, when required to reduce wastage of said water.

Description:FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001] The present invention relates to a portable door locking assistive device that is capable of providing enhanced security for premises by reinforcing door locking mechanisms against unauthorized access. 

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
 
[0002] The process of locking and unlocking doors requires users to manually align and secure various mechanisms, often involving bending down or reaching awkwardly to ensure that the device fits properly under the door. This manual approach, while functional, presents several challenges, including the physical effort required to position and adjust the locking mechanism, which can lead to improper placement and reduced effectiveness. Additionally, frequent manual handling can result in strain or discomfort, particularly when repeated use is necessary, making the traditional methods both inefficient and physically demanding. 

[0003] Traditional approach to door locking is not only physically taxing but also prone to errors such as improper alignment, which can compromise the effectiveness of the locking mechanism. Users are often required to make manual adjustments to ensure that the locking device is securely positioned, a process that can be time-consuming and not always provide the desired level of convenience or reliability. Moreover, the repetitive nature of these tasks increases the risk of strain or injury, especially when force is required to secure the door. Therefore, there is a need for a device that automates the door locking process, offering a user-friendly solution that simplifies the task while minimizing physical effort and ensuring consistent, reliable results. 

[0004] US20140265359A1 discloses an intelligent door lock system is provided with a position sensing device configured to be coupled to a drive shaft of a lock device. The position sensing device senses position of the drive shaft and assists in locking and unlocking a lock of a lock device. An engine is provided with a memory coupled to the positioning sensing device. A circuit is coupled to the engine and an energy source is coupled to the circuit. A device converts energy into mechanical energy and is coupled to the circuit, positioning sensing device and the drive shaft. The device that converts energy is coupled to the energy source to receive energy from the energy source. Although US’359 discloses about an invention that provides to door lock devices, and more particularly to intelligent door lock devices. However, the citied invention lacks in adapting to the physical dimensions of different doors and ground surfaces to ensure proper alignment and securement.

[0005] US20180191889A1 reveals systems and methods are provided for operating a remotely operable lock. In an example embodiment, a method comprises receiving credentials at a web service from a portable electronic device, authenticating the credentials, and based on a successful authentication, issuing a command for receipt by the lock from the web service or the portable electronic device. Although US’889 discloses about an invention that can remotely operate lock to open and close the door. However, the citied invention lacks in facilitating user interaction through voice commands and providing real-time feedback to enhance ease of use and effectiveness.
 
[0006] Conventionally, many devices are capable of automatically locking the doors but lacks in facilitating user interaction through voice commands and providing real-time feedback to enhance ease of use and effectiveness.

[0007] In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a device that is capable of providing enhanced security for premises by offering a portable solution that reinforces door locking mechanisms against unauthorized access and also capable of automatically adapting to the physical dimensions of different doors and ground surfaces to ensure proper alignment and securement.

 OBJECTS OF THE INVENTION

[0008]  The principal object of the present invention is to overcome the disadvantages of the prior art.

[0009]  An object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of providing enhanced security for premises by offering a portable solution that reinforces door locking mechanisms against unauthorized access.

[0010] Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of automatically adapting to the physical dimensions of different doors and ground surface to ensure proper alignment and securement.

[0011]  Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of detecting and responding to forced entry attempts by deploying additional stabilization measures and alerting occupants.

[0012] Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of facilitating user interaction through voice commands and providing real-time feedback to enhance ease of use and effectiveness.
     
[0013]  The foregoing and other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become readily apparent upon further review of the following detailed description of the preferred embodiment as illustrated in the accompanying drawings.

SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

[0014]  The present invention relates to a portable door locking assistive device that is capable of detecting and responding to forced entry attempts by deploying additional stabilization measures. In addition, the proposed device is also capable of alerting occupants through audio signals, providing an immediate warning of any unauthorized attempts to breach the security of the premises.

[0015]  According to an embodiment of the present invention, a portable door locking assistive device, comprises of a L-shaped body having a first and second portion, first portion is developed to be positioned underneath bottom portion of a door of a premises, a microphone integrated into the body for enabling a user to provide input voice commands regarding requirement of assistance in locking the door, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit integrated in the body and paired with a processor for capturing and processing multiple images in vicinity of the body to determine dimensions of spacing in between the door and ground surface beneath the door, a horizontal plate is arranged with the first portion through a pair of extendable rods to extend/retract for positioning the plate on the ground surface, in view of covering the spacing, a primary set of suction cups are arranged beneath the plate for adhering to the surface, thus properly securing the body beneath the door, a circular flap installed on backside of the second portion by means of a L-shaped rod that is actuated by the microcontroller to extend/retract for placing the flap onto the ground surface, a secondary set of suction cups are arranged underneath the flap to the surface, in view of providing an additional immovability to the body, thereby facilitating the user in locking the door as per the user’s requirements.

[0016] According to another embodiment of the present invention, the proposed device further comprises of a impact sensor is embedded in the body for detecting pushing of the door by an intruder, due to which the body experiences, based on which the microcontroller actuates an electromagnetic spring integrated in between the rod and flap for expanding/contracting to dampen the jerks experienced by the body, thus ensuring stability of the body for locking the door, a speaker is installed on the body to produce audio signals for notifying individuals inside the premises regarding the forced entry, protecting the individuals from any harmful actions of the intruder, a battery is configured with the device for providing a continuous power supply to electronically powered components associated with the device.

[0017]  While the invention has been described and shown with particular reference to the preferred embodiment, it will be apparent that variations might be possible that would fall within the scope of the present invention.

[0022] The present invention relates to a portable door locking assistive device that is capable of enhancing user interaction through voice command functionality. Furthermore, the proposed device is also capable of providing real-time feedback and adjusting its operation based on specific user requirements, ensuring ease of use and effectiveness in securing the premises.

[0023] Referring to Figure 1, a isometric view of a portable door locking assistive device is illustrated comprising of a L-shaped body 101 having a first portion 102 and second portion 103, a microphone 104 integrated into the body 101, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 105 integrated in the body 101, a horizontal plate 106 is arranged with the first portion 102 through a pair of extendable rods 107, a primary set of suction cups 108 are arranged beneath the plate 106, a circular flap 109 installed on backside of the second portion 103 by means of a L-shaped rod 110, a secondary set of suction cups 111 are arranged underneath the flap 109, an electromagnetic spring 112 integrated in between the rod 107 and flap 109, a speaker 113 is installed on the body 101. 

[0024] The device disclosed herein includes a L-shaped body 101 having a first and second portion, wherein the first portion 102 is developed to be positioned underneath bottom portion of a door of a premises. 

[0025] The user is required to provide input voice commands for locking the door via a microphone 104 integrated into the body 101 for enabling a user to provide input voice commands regarding requirement of assistance in locking the door. The microphone 104 works as a transducer that converts sound waves into audio signal. The microphone 104 on receiving the input from the user converts the input signal into electrical signal and sends it to the microcontroller. The microcontroller on receiving the signals actuates an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 105 integrated in the body 101 and paired with a processor for capturing and processing multiple images in vicinity of the body 101. 

[0026] The imaging unit 105 comprises of an image capturing arrangement including a set of lenses that captures multiple images in surrounding in order to determine dimensions of spacing in between the door and ground surface beneath the door, and the captured images are stored within memory of the imaging unit 105 in form of an optical data. The imaging unit 105 also comprises of a processor that is integrated with artificial intelligence protocols, such that the processor processes the optical data and extracts the required data from the captured images. The extracted data is further converted into digital pulses and bits and are further transmitted to the microcontroller. The microcontroller processes the received data and determines dimensions of spacing in between the door and ground surface beneath the door. 

[0027] After determining the dimensions of spacing in between the door and ground, the microcontroller actuates a pair of extendable rods 107 attached with a horizontal plate 106 arranged with the first portion 102 to extend/retract for positioning the plate 106 on the ground surface. 

[0028] The extension/retraction of the extendable rods 107 is powered pneumatically by the microcontroller by employing a pneumatic unit associated with the rods 107, including an air compressor, air cylinders, air valves and piston which works in collaboration to aid in extension and retraction of the rods 107. The pneumatic unit is operated by the microcontroller, such that the microcontroller actuates valve to allow passage of compressed air from the compressor within the cylinder, the compressed air further develops pressure against the piston and results in pushing and extending the piston. The piston is connected with the rods 107 and due to applied pressure the rods 107 extends and similarly, the microcontroller retracts the rods 107 by closing the valve resulting in retraction of the piston. Thus, the microcontroller regulates the extension/retraction of the rods 107 in order to positioning the plate 106 on the ground surface, in view of covering the spacing determined by the imaging unit. The plate 106 is arranged with set of suction cups 108 beneath the plate 106 for sticking to the surface.

[0029] The multiple suction cups 108 used herein are made up of silicone rubber that easily eliminates pressure inside the suction cup and creating a vacuum between the cup and the surface which creates an air-tight seal, for adhering to the surface, in order to properly securing the body 101 beneath the door. 

[0030] After securing the body 101 properly, the microcontroller actuates a L-shaped rod 110 attached with a circular flap 109 installed on the backside of the second portion 103 to extend/retract for placing the flap 109 onto the ground surface, The L-shaped rod 110 mentioned herein works in the same manner as explained above for the extendable rod. A secondary set of suction cups 111 are arranged underneath the flap 109 to the surface for providing an additional immovability to the body 101. The secondary set of suction cups 111 works in the same manner as explained above. Thereby, facilitating the user in locking the door as per the user’s requirements.

[0031] If pushing is detected on the door by an intruder, the microcontroller in association with an impact sensor embedded in the body 101 for detecting pushing. The impact sensor typically comprises a piezoelectric element, a microcontroller, and an amplifier. Upon impact, the piezoelectric element generates a small electrical charge due to mechanical stress. This charge is amplified by the sensor's internal circuitry to produce a measurable voltage signal. The microcontroller processes this signal to determine the magnitude of the impact. Based on predefined thresholds, the microcontroller actuates an electromagnetic spring 112 integrated in between the rod and flap 109 for expanding/contracting to dampen the jerks experienced by the body 101.

[0032] The electromagnetic spring 112 is a specialized type of spring 112 in which the magnetic field is produced by an electric current. When the current is passed through the spring 112, it creates a magnetic field around the spring 112 to dampen the jerks experienced by the body 101 when the intruder pushes the door, thus ensuring stability of the body 101 for locking the door.

[0033] If an intruder enters through the door by force, the microcontroller actuates a speaker 113 installed on the body 101 to produce audio signals for notifying that some intruder entered the premises. The speaker 113 works by receiving signals from the microcontroller, converting them into sound waves through a diaphragm’s vibration, and producing audible sounds with the help of amplification and control circuitry in order to notify the individuals inside the premises regarding the forced entry, thus protecting the individuals from any harmful actions of the intruder.

[0034] A battery is associated with the device to offer power to all electrical and electronic components necessary for their correct operation. The battery is linked to the microcontroller and provides (DC) Direct Current to the microcontroller. And then, based on the order of operations, the microcontroller sends that current to those specific electrical or electronic components so they effectively carry out their appropriate functions.

[0035] The present works best in the following manner, where the device comprises of the L-shaped body 101 having a first and second portion, a microphone 104 integrated for enabling a user to provide input voice commands regarding requirement of assistance in locking the door, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 105 and paired with a processor for capturing and processing multiple images in vicinity of the body 101 to determine dimensions of spacing in between the door and ground surface beneath the door, a horizontal plate 106 through a pair of extendable rods 107 to extend/retract for positioning the plate 106 on the ground surface, a primary set of suction cups 108 for properly securing the body 101 beneath the door, a circular flap 109 by means of a L-shaped rod 110 to extend/retract for placing the flap 109 onto the ground surface, a secondary set of suction cups 111 provides an additional immovability to the body 101, the impact sensor for detecting pushing of the door by an intruder, due to which the body 101 experiences, an electromagnetic spring 112 for expanding/contracting to dampen the jerks experienced by the body 101, a speaker 113 to produce audio signals for notifying individuals inside the premises regarding the forced entry, protecting the individuals from any harmful actions of the intruder.

Various modifications of the disclosed embodiments, as well as alternate embodiments of the invention, will become apparent to persons skilled in the art upon reference to the description of the invention.  , Claims:1) A portable door locking assistive device, comprising:

iii) a horizontal plate 106 is arranged with said first portion 102 through a pair of extendable rods 107 that are actuated by an inbuilt microcontroller to extend/retract for positioning said plate 106 on said ground surface, in view of covering said spacing, wherein a primary set of suction cups 108 are arranged beneath said plate 106 for adhering to said surface, thus properly securing said body 101 beneath said door; and
iv) a circular flap 109 installed on backside of said second portion 103 by means of a L-shaped rod 110 that is actuated by said microcontroller to extend/retract for placing said flap 109 onto said ground surface, wherein a secondary set of suction cups 111 are arranged underneath said flap 109 to said surface, in view of providing an additional immovability to said body 101, thereby facilitating said user in locking said door as per said user’s requirements.

4) The device as claimed in claim 1, wherein a battery is configured with said device for providing a continuous power supply to electronically powered components associated with said device.

Description:FIELD OF THE INVENTION

[0001] The present invention relates to an adaptable items organizing assistive device that is capable of providing a means to assist a user in arranging different items inside a car in organized manner and prevent any items to fall beneath car seat and charging facilities for different electric appliances in the car thereby preventing any discomfort to the user during driving the car.

BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION
 
[0002]  Items organization in a car plays an important role in ensuring a safe and comfortable driving experience. Keeping items securely stored and easily accessible that help to prevent distractions and maintain a clutter-free environment while on the road. Having a designated place for each item also makes it easier to locate things quickly, reducing the need to take the user’s eyes off the road for extended periods. This is ultimately to contribute to a smoother and more focused driving experience. Furthermore, proper organization also help in emergency situations by allowing quick access to essential items like first aid kits or tools. Overall, taking the time to organize the car lead to a more enjoyable and stress-free driving experience. In addition, keeping user’s car organized also improve safety by reducing the risk of loose items becoming projectiles in the event of a sudden stop or collision. It is important to regularly declutter and maintain organization in the user’s vehicle to ensure a safe and efficient driving experience. 

[0003] Traditionally, the user uses tools for organizing items in the car that includes seat organizers, trunk organizers, and car hooks. These tools help keep the car clutter-free and make it easier to find items when needed. Newer tools such as car storage boxes and backseat organizers have also become popular for maximizing space and keeping essentials easily accessible while on the go. These modern options offer additional compartments and features to further enhance organization within the vehicle. Overall, having a variety of organizational tools for the car the greatly improve the driving experience by reducing stress and increasing efficiency but lacks in providing charging facilities to the appliances with such tools.

[0004]  US20100084883A1 discloses a device for use in conjunction with a console on a seat in a vehicle. The device enables an individual to maintain an office for business within a vehicle, such as a truck. The device includes a base unit which surrounds the console and is equipped with compartments, receptacles, writing surfaces and devices to support and retain electronic devices, such as lap top computers. The device includes a base unit. A plurality of writing surfaces and other compartments can be removable secured to the base unit. The writing surfaces can be provided with additional supports which are secured to the under surface of the writing surface. The additional supports are designed to contact the seat of a vehicle and provide additional support for the writing surface. A compartment which is adapted to retain items such as cell phones, pagers and beverage vessels is releasably secured to a front of the base unit. A compartment which is adapted to retain items such as hanging files and beverage vessels is releasably secured to a rear of the base unit. A device to removable support an electronic device, such as a lap top computer, can be secured to the device. A strap extends from one of the sides of the base unit to the other side across the bottom of the base unit. The strap is used to help secure the device to a center console of a vehicle. Although, US’883 provides way to add removable support to an electronic device, such as a lap top computer, can be secured to the device, however, above cited device lacks in providing charging facilities for that electronic device.

[0005] Conventionally, many devices are disclosed in prior art that provides way to organize items in the car while driving but lacks in providing proper visibility inside the car for maintaining optimum illumination around the surroundings. Moreover, such devices are lacks in providing charging port with the devices as additional charging facilities.

[0006] In order to overcome the aforementioned drawbacks, there exists a need in the art to develop a device that is capable of assisting a user in organizing items in the car while driving with proper visibility inside the car for maintaining optimum illumination around surroundings and providing charging port as additional charging facilities. 

 OBJECTS OF THE INVENTION

[0007]  The principal object of the present invention is to overcome the disadvantages of the prior art.

[0008]  An object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of assisting a user arranging different items inside a car in organized manner and prevent any items to fall beneath car seat thus preventing any discomfort to the user while driving. 

[0009] Another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of allowing the user to accommodate the user’s commodities including but not limited to smartphones, tablets and documents for making available for utilization during traveling as per requirement.

[0010]  Yet another object of the present invention is to develop a device that is capable of facilitating the user in charging the accommodated electrical appliances, thereby assisting the user in carrying user-desired commodities with minimal discomfort.
  
[0011]  The foregoing and other objects, features, and advantages of the present invention will become readily apparent upon further review of the following detailed description of the preferred embodiment as illustrated in the accompanying drawings.

SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

[0012]  The present invention relates to an adaptable items organizing assistive device that is capable of assisting a user in arranging different items to prevent any discomfort to the user while driving and finding the fallen items easily organize multiple objects within the car.

[0013]  According to an embodiment of the present invention, an adaptable items organizing assistive device, comprises of a curved body constructed with a curved plate and a flap be positioned on gaps in between car’s seat and interior console of the car, a microphone integrated in the body for enabling the user to provide input voice commands regarding installation of the device, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit integrated in the body to determine dimensions of the gaps, a drawer arrangement integrated in the body that is actuated by an inbuilt microcontroller to increase/decrease dimensions of the plate for properly aligning with the gaps, multiple suction cups assembled on peripheral portion of the plate to adhere to the console’s surface for securing the plate in the gaps, multiple hooks are installed on the curved plate for enabling the user to hang objects including but not limited to keys and rings to easily organize multiple objects within the car, multiple slots provided on the curved plate to allow the user to accommodate the user’s commodities including but not limited to smartphones, tablets and documents, a USB (Universal Serial Bus) port is integrated in the plate for facilitating the user in charging the accommodated electrical appliances, a proximity sensor embedded in the body for detecting presence of the user in proximity to the body, LEDs (Light Emitting Diodes) arranged on the body to emit the light for maintaining optimum illumination around the surroundings, and a battery configured with the device for providing a continuous power supply to electronically powered components associated with the device.

[0019] The present invention relates to an adaptable items organizing assistive device that is capable of organizing items and commodities inside a car with minimal discomfort along with facilitating the user in charging the accommodated electrical appliances, thereby assisting the user in carrying user-desired commodities in appropriate manner.

[0020]  Referring to Figure 1, an isometric view of an adaptable items organizing assistive device is illustrated, comprising a curved body 101 constructed with a curved plate 102 and a flap 103, an artificial intelligence-based imaging unit 104 integrated in the body 101, multiple suction cups 106 arranged on peripheral portion of the plate 102, multiple hooks 107 installed on the curved plate 102, multiple slots 108 provided on the curved plate 102, a USB (Universal Serial Bus) port 109 integrated in the plate 102, multiple LEDs (Light Emitting Diodes) 110 arranged on the body 101, and microphone 105 integrated in the body 101.

[0021]  The proposed device comprises of a curved body 101 constructed with a curved plate 102 and a flap 103 encased with various component with various components associated with the device arranged in sequential manner that aids in assisting a user in organizing items. Herein, the body 101 is developed to be placed on gaps in between a car’s seat and interior console of the car. After placement of the body 101 in the gap, the user now requires to activate the device manually by pressing a push button integrated on the body 101. The button is type of a switch that is internally connected with the device via multiple circuits that upon pressing by the user, the circuits get closed and starts conduction of electricity that tends to activate the device and vice versa. 

[0022] After activating of the device by the user, a microcontroller associated with the device generates a commands to operate the device accordingly. Upon activating the device, the microcontroller actuates a microphone 105 integrated with the body 101 to give access to the user for giving voice commands regarding installation of the device. The microphone 105 receives sound waves generated by energy emitted from the voice command in the form of vibrations. After then, the sound waves are transmitted towards a diaphragm configured with a coil. Upon transmitting the waves within the diaphragm, the diaphragm strikes with the waves due to which the coil starts moving the diaphragm with a back-and-forth movement in presence of magnetic field generated from the coil.

[0023] After that the electric signal is emitted from the coil due to back-and-forth movement of the diaphragm which is further transmitted to the microcontroller linked with the microphone 105 to process the signal to analyze the signal for detecting voice command given by the user. Upon processing the voice commands, the microcontroller actuates an artificial intelligence based imaging unit 104 integrated with the body 101 to detect dimensions of the gaps. The imaging unit 104, disclosed herein comprises of a camera and processor that works in collaboration to capture and process the images in a vicinity of the body 101. 

[0024] The camera firstly captures multiple images of the vicinity of the body 101, wherein the camera comprises of a body, electronic shutter, lens, lens aperture, image sensor, and imaging processor that works in sequential manner to capture images of the vicinity of the body 101. After capturing of the images by the camera, the shutter is automatically open due to which the reflected beam of light coming from the surrounding due to light is directed towards the lens aperture. After then the reflected light beam passes through the image sensor. The sensor now analyzes the beam to retrieve signal from the beams which is further calibrate by the sensor to capture images of the vicinity of the body 101 in electronic signal. 

[0025] Upon capturing images, the imaging processor processes the electronic signal into digital image. When the capturing is done, the processor associated with the imaging unit 104 processes the captured images by using a protocol of artificial intelligence to retrieve data from the captured image in the form of digital signal. The detected data is now transmitted to the microcontroller based on which the microcontroller acquires the data to detect the dimensions of the gaps. Based on the detected dimensions, the microcontroller actuates a drawer arrangement 105 integrated in the body 101 to extend ad retract to change the size of the plate 102 as per detected dimensions of the gaps. The drawer arrangement 105 comprises of a carriage assembly and a DC (direct current) motor that works in collaboration to extend and retract the body 101. The carriage assembly fitted with two rails that are used for sliding the block up and down. The block opening located at the end of the rail and have two clips that are used to secure the ring with the barrel. To extend the drawer, the drawer is pushed to open and the carriage assembly slide outward. This creates an opening to allow extension and retraction of the arrangement 105 to change the size of the plate 102 as per detected dimensions of the gaps.

[0026] Simultaneously, the microcontroller actuates multiple suction cups 106 integrated on peripheral portion of the plate 102 to adhere the console’s surface for securing the plate 102 in the gaps. The suction cup 106 operates by combining a suction cup's traditional ability to create a vacuum seal with a motorized mechanism that enhances its performance. The suction cup 106 itself, typically made of flexible rubber or silicone, adheres to smooth surfaces by removing air between the cup 106 and the surface, creating a vacuum by continuously adjusting the suction force or automating the application and release of the vacuum over the surface to adhere the plate 102 for securing the plate 102 in the gaps for preventing any items to fall beneath the car seat thereby eliminates any discomfort to the user during driving and finding the fallen items. 

[0027] The user, herein utilize multiple hooks 107 integrated on the curved plate 102 to hang objects including but not limited to keys and rings to easily organize multiple objects within the car. Further, multiple slots 108 provided on the curved plate 102 to aid the user to accommodate the user’s commodities including but not limited to smartphones, tablets and documents as per requirements. Additionally, a USB (Universal Serial Bus) port 109 integrated in the plate 102 for enabling the user in charging the accommodated electrical appliances for assisting the user in carrying user-desired commodities with minimal discomfort. The USB port 109 operates using a standardized protocol to facilitate communication between the microcontroller and the device. When the electrical appliance is plugged into the USB port 109, the port 109 sends a signal to the device to identify itself and establish a connection. The USB controller within the microcontroller manages this interaction, allocating bandwidth and power as needed. Herein, Data is transmitted in packets using a serial communication method, meaning bits of data are sent one after another over the same channel through a process called multiplexing to deliver power supply through the USB port 109, allowing appliance to charge or operate without needing an additional power source from a battery (not shown in figure) associated with the device.

[0028] The battery offers power to all electrical and electronic components necessary for their correct operation. The battery is linked to the microcontroller and provides (DC) Direct Current to the microcontroller. And then, based on the order of operations, the microcontroller sends that current to those specific electrical or electronic components so they effectively carry out their appropriate functions.

[0029] Additionally, a proximity sensor integrated in the body 101 detects presence of the user in proximity to the body 101. The proximity sensor operates by emitting a signal—such as electromagnetic waves, infrared light, or ultrasonic sound—and measuring the changes in the signal caused by the presence of the user triggering a response. Herein, the proximity sensor preferably includes but not limited to optical sensors emits light and detect the reflected light from the user.
